name: Sweet Treat
source:
You're new to this city, having moved to pursue a new line of work. Having come from a quiet village, life here is a bit more exhausting than you expected. You find yourself in need of a quiet place with a cozy atmosphere, to clear your mind while you work and stumble across a maid cafe on your route home.

The thing is, the girls here are really cute and your visits for peace and quiet might end up more along the lines of distractions...

[From [url=https://emituga.itch.io/sweet-treat]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是这座城市的新人，刚刚搬家去从事新的工作。来自安静的村庄，这里的生活比你想象的要累一些。你发现自己需要一个安静且氛围舒适的地方，以便在工作时理清思绪，并在回家的路上偶然发现了一家女仆咖啡馆。

问题是，这里的女孩真的很可爱，你为了平和与安静而来这里可能最终会更多地分散注意力……

[来自[url=https://emituga.itch.io/sweet-treat]itch.io[/url]]
